recognize_zh: 這是流式細胞儀圖：先以 SSC 對 CD15 圈出顆粒球，再看 FLAER 與 CD55/CD59；正常人顆粒球全落在雙陽性區，PNH 病人約 85.8% 顆粒球落在 FLAER 陰性、CD55/59 陰性的左下象限，代表大型 PNH 克隆（GPI 錨定蛋白缺失）。
features: Granulocytes gated on SSC versus CD15 (red population) in both normal and patient samples
Normal control: 99.88% of granulocytes are FLAER-positive and CD55/CD59-positive (upper right quadrant)
PNH patient: 85.83% of granulocytes are FLAER-negative and CD55/CD59-negative (lower left quadrant), the type III PNH clone
PNH patient: residual 12.79% FLAER/CD55/CD59-positive normal neutrophils
Discrete separation between clone and normal cells, with few events in intermediate positions
describe_en: Peripheral blood high-sensitivity flow cytometry for PNH. Granulocytes were gated on side scatter versus CD15 and assessed for FLAER binding and CD55/CD59 expression. In the normal control, 99.88% of granulocytes co-express FLAER and CD55/CD59. In the patient sample, 85.83% of granulocytes lack both FLAER binding and CD55/CD59 expression, with a residual 12.79% normal granulocyte population. Findings demonstrate a large PNH clone involving approximately 86% of granulocytes, consistent with paroxysmal nocturnal hemoglobinuria; correlation with red cell (CD59, type II/III) and monocyte clone sizes, LDH, and marrow findings is recommended.

ddx.dx: Small PNH clone in aplastic anemia or MDS
ddx.vs: Clone size is typically below 10% of granulocytes, whereas this sample shows an 86% clone.
Isolated CD59 deficiency involves all cells with preserved FLAER binding because other GPI-anchored proteins remain intact.
Immature myeloid cells may show dim CD55/CD59 but retain FLAER binding and do not form a discrete double-negative population.
